description: This file contains API functions for managing queries, including saving, listing, retrieving, deleting, toggling favorites, and fetching query history. It handles both mock data for testing and real API calls for production.

methods.name: saveQuery({ name, protocol, deviceId, parameters, isFavorite = false })
methods.description: Saves a query configuration for reuse, either returning mock data or posting to an API endpoint.

methods.name: listQueries({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, favorites = false } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of saved queries, with optional filtering for favorites.

methods.name: getQueryById(queryId)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific query identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteQuery(queryId)
methods.description: Deletes a query by its ID, returning success status.

methods.name: toggleFavorite(queryId, isFavorite)
methods.description: Updates the favorite status of a query.

methods.name: getQueryHistory({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, protocol, deviceId } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves the history of query executions with optional filtering.

ctags.name: getQueryHistory
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getQueryHistory({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, protocol, deviceId } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: listQueries
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listQueries({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, favorites = false } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: saveQuery
ctags.pattern: /^export async function saveQuery({ name, protocol, deviceId, parameters, isFavorite = false }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ name, protocol, deviceId, parameters, isFavorite = false })
